# ExifTool test image

`Olympus.jpg` is copied unchanged from the ExifTool 13.59 distribution (`t/images/Olympus.jpg`,
an Olympus C2000Z JPEG with old-style Olympus maker notes). It is used to test the repair of
maker-note offsets broken by other programs (COMPATIBILITY.md finding 15).
